model_adapter_contract.note: interfaces + deterministic test stubs ONLY; challengers are UNFITTED stubs in v0.1
model_adapter_contract.fit_rule: fit() raises FittingNotAuthorised unless an explicit future authorization token is supplied (never supplied this stage)
model_adapter_contract.predict_rule: deterministic stub predictions for plumbing/tests; no learned parameters exist

split_contract.group_key: campaign_id (no campaign row may appear in more than one split)
split_contract.scheme: walk-forward expanding train window; evaluate on the next fold
split_contract.eligibility_enforced: only rows with eligible_for_training=true enter train; eligible_for_validation for eval
split_contract.feature_allowlist: DECISION_TIME_FEATURE + IDENTITY/PROVENANCE only; POST_DECISION_LABEL fields HARD-REJECTED as features

metric_contract.small_sample: returns INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE rather than misleading statistics

promotion_contract.rollback_metadata: champion + challenger versions + dataset hash recorded; no promotion executed
promotion_contract.authorization_required: explicit future review + learning-activation gate ratification
